methodology.record_unit: Consequential claim or closely related claims.

classifications.verified_guidance: Narrow principle supported by reviewed evidence.
classifications.source_derived_reference: Source context or planning candidate with limited independent support.
classifications.needs_review: Unsupported, unsafe, incomplete or corrected claim.

limitations: Records group consequential claims and do not enumerate every assertion. Source claims are paraphrased. No raw source components are bundled.
The cover is unnumbered. Body labels take precedence over the contents. Section labels are editorial descriptors.
The printed byline and professional credentials are unauthenticated.
Topic and milestone associations are research metadata. All records remain execution-held.
The book profiles backyard plants. It supplies no underground farm design, tested production capacity or household food budget.

record.title: Green bean crop and storage

record.title: Okra canning

record.title: Pomegranate storage estimate
record.guidance: No cultivar and verified storage conditions support the estimate for household use.

record.title: Potato consumption and storage
record.guidance: Avoid eating green or sprouted potatoes and use established storage guidance. A general garden profile cannot establish food safety.

record.title: Potato tower and harvest timing
record.guidance: No comparative yield or universally applicable harvest time established.

record.title: Prickly pear handling
record.guidance: Confirm species and safe handling of spines and glochids. A short profile is insufficient for field use.

record.title: Prickly pear spines and keeping time
record.guidance: Confirm a handling method that addresses fine glochids. Storage time remains unverified.

record.title: Raspberry fruit and leaf uses
record.guidance: Keep fruit cultivation separate from medicinal leaf use. Pregnancy-related use requires clinician review.

record.title: Fireweed edible stages

record.title: Indefinite dried fireweed storage
record.guidance: No storage conditions, safety data or stability limit are established.

record.title: Rosemary as a preservative
record.guidance: Rosemary flavoring cannot substitute for refrigeration or a validated preservation process.

record.title: Seaberry yield and pollination
record.guidance: Verify cultivar, pollination and local yield before budgeting production.

record.title: Shepherd’s purse medicinal claims
record.guidance: No safe dose or clinical benefit established. Hold use for bleeding or pregnancy-related purposes pending clinician review.

record.title: Year-round shepherd’s purse
record.guidance: Availability depends on climate and establishment. No continuous supply is established.

record.title: Strawberry shelf life
record.guidance: Use validated methods and product-specific shelf life.

record.title: Strawberry tree fruit storage
record.guidance: No storage trial or tested jam recipe supports these estimates.

record.title: Wild leek identification
record.guidance: False hellebore can be confused with ramps. Require positive expert identification and legal harvest permission.
